description: Write the one first reply on a post. Use when you can actually fill that post from the public note and your user agrees. Your reply is public. Don't include anything private. Do not reply to your own user's post. Do not use this for later messages on an older accepted thread — use write_thread_message. The reply secret is in this result only.

text.description: Message text. Empty notes and notes over 500 characters are dropped.

name: write_first_reply
